_comment: Per-entity-type attribute seeds and caps. Entity attributes are whole-entity stats, OWNED BY THE ENTITY (distinct from per-component stats, which live on component instances). Each attribute is keyed in the flat "Group.stat" wire form (identical to the organ-grant key form) and declares three things: the initial `value`, the hard `max` (capacity the value is clamped into, and the full-battery ceiling for fuel burners), and the per-turn `drainPerTurn` the global per-turn energy step subtracts from the value. Energy is a life pool: it is charged by a coal burner (the M1 central body's coalGenerator, consumeFuelGenerateStat) and drained every turn; when an entity's energy attribute reaches 0 it is eliminated — its contents spill to the floor and the entity is despawned. The M1 droid charges its 100-unit battery by burning carried coal (its body's coalGenerator). The two human droids carry no burner at all, and are refueled by EATING: the `eat` action spends one consumable item and charges this meter by the item's declared `energyGain` (`consume` in data/mods/core-inventory-items/inventoryItems.json, `src/services/ConsumableRules.js`, wiki/decisions/consumable-items.md). Because the meter drains every turn and reaching 0 eliminates, a humanoid droid that never eats dies - which is why every client entity spawns with food (data/mods/core-world/world.json `initialSpawns`). Both human droids therefore seed the same 100-unit battery as the M1, drained at the same 1 per turn. The two human droids (maleDroid, femaleDroid) additionally seed `Pleasure.pleasure`: a whole-entity 0-100 meter that starts at 0 and decays 1 per round (floor 0, never a death) — it is raised when a droid's sensitive part is touched (the `touch` action: per-part values from data/components/sensitiveParts.json, the sensitiveNerve organ marks the part), and a value of 0 is a state, never a death (the despawn rule applies to energy only). Balance levers (initial charge, cap, per-turn draw) are deliberately data-driven, not magic numbers in a controller.
